meanings.en: little family, clan (often ironic or derogatory)

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'signet / gem ring' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: He sold that ring and moved abroad.

examples.trans: I wish I had a ring like that!

meanings.en: to film, to take a photo/video of
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'нять'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will take off', paired with 'снимать'.

examples.text: Они могут снять весь отель.
examples.trans: They can rent the entire hotel.

examples.text: Я сняла пьяного соседа на телефон.
examples.trans: I filmed a drunk neighbour on my phone.

examples.text: Он снял пальто у двери.
examples.trans: He took off his coat by the door.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'hour' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Сейчас приготовим лучше всех!
examples.trans: We will cook it better than anyone right now!

examples.text: Слушай, сейчас шеф получит наш перстень.
examples.trans: Listen, now the Chef will get our ring.

examples.text: Всё понятно, сейчас шейха напоят, а он их отблагодарит.
examples.trans: Everything is clear, now they will get the sheikh drunk and he will reward them.

examples.text: Гораздо раньше в отель прибывают слухи.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'dinner, supper (evening meal)' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Через час у шейха ужин, а это заказ в номер.

examples.trans: Yulya, it is time for dinner.

examples.text: Меня на ужин позвали!
examples.trans: They called me to dinner!

meanings.en: to carry, deliver something to a place
meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'нести'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will take / bring', paired with 'относить'.

examples.text: Одна девушка отнесла ему заказ и пропала.
examples.trans: One girl brought him an order and vanished.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('molecular').

examples.text: Давай я отнесу, это молекулярное блюдо, надо в номере доделать.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary
meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Давай я отнесу, это молекулярное блюдо, надо в номере доделать.
examples.trans: Let me take it, this is a molecular dish, it must be finished in the room.

examples.text: Найди её одежду и надень.
examples.trans: Find her clothes and put them on.

examples.text: Мне нужно ненадолго отлучиться.
examples.trans: I need to step away for a moment.

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'делать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to finish making'.

related.gloss: not to to finish making (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Давай я отнесу, это молекулярное блюдо, надо в номере доделать.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и доделать вовремя.
